description: What HBMeasure is for agents: non-refundable structure/roof measurement reports sold via Stripe (card or crypto) or by x402 (USDC on Base): $1.00 report, $0.05 coverage check, $0.25 building code lookup. Prices: $1.00 by x402 (USDC), $1.34 by card (covers the card processing fee). Agents cannot book Hyperion inspections. Returns purchase rules and discovery URLs. Terms of sale: All sales are final. Each report is computed for your address when you order, so we cannot offer refunds once an order is placed. If we cannot produce a report for your address, the order is recorded and our staff will follow up with you; we may re-run it or issue a replacement report. Measurements are estimates graded Verified / Measured / Estimated; check them before ordering materials or relying on them for a claim or contract.
